name: ae-external-skills
description: Agent Everywhere's shareable skills. Install only the ones you need.

plugins.name: grokbot
plugins.description: Operate your Grok Bot desktop app from Claude Code on your Mac: agents, groups, sections, pins, transcripts, send --wait. Unofficial; needs Node 20+.

plugins.name: grokbot-box
plugins.description: For a Grok Bot agent inside its own cloud box: manage sibling Grok Bot workers (list, create, organize, send, delete) under an advisory agent policy. Unofficial.

plugins.name: claude-desktop
plugins.description: Operate the Claude Desktop app on your Mac from Claude Code: tasks, replies, approvals, projects, skills, connectors. Unofficial; needs macOS 15+ and Peekaboo.

plugins.name: sales-navigator
plugins.description: Sales Navigator toolkit: exact counts, account and lead searches through the in-page API, CSV and cap-tracking scripts. Runs in your own browser (local) or Agent Browser.
